short_description: Users need a clear emergency exit from unwanted states without extended dialogue.

positive.definition: Destructive actions are reversible via undo or trash with a recovery window
positive.evidence_required: name the action and the undo affordance

positive.definition: Modals and forms have a clearly visible cancel or close affordance
positive.evidence_required: name the modal and the close control

positive.definition: Multi-step flows preserve back-navigation that does not lose user input
positive.evidence_required: name the flow and what survives a back navigation

positive.definition: Active filters or selections can be cleared with a single visible control
positive.evidence_required: name the filter set and the clear control

positive.definition: Escape key dismisses modals, dropdowns, and overlays
positive.evidence_required: name the surface and the keyboard behavior

negative.definition: Destructive action runs without confirmation and without undo
negative.evidence_required: name the action and the lack of confirmation or recovery

negative.definition: Modal has no visible close affordance and ignores escape key
negative.evidence_required: name the modal and how a user could exit

negative.definition: Browser back or in-app back loses entered data without warning
negative.evidence_required: name the form and the lost field

negative.definition: Active filters cannot be cleared without page reload or per-filter manipulation
negative.evidence_required: name the filter and the missing clear control

critical_negative.definition: User can be trapped in a state with no exit other than browser refresh
critical_negative.evidence_required: name the trap state and the missing exit
